name: Ingenta plc
summary: Ingenta plc, together with its subsidiaries, provides content management, advertising, and commercial enterprise solutions and services in the United Kingdom, the United States, and internationally. The company operates through Ingenta Commercial Products, Ingenta Content Products, Ingenta Advertising, and Publishers Communication Group (PCG) segments. The Ingenta Commercial segment provides a range of applications designed to move content forward in marketplace for print and digital products, such as royalties, permissions, editorial and production, online sales and marketing, digital and print distribution, and subscription management. The Ingenta Content segment comprising various hosting platforms that enable publishers to convert, store, deliver and monetise digital content, including online platforms, semantic enrichment, mobile, e-commerce, and access entitlement services. The Ingenta Advertising segment provides browser-based multimedia advertising, CRM, and sales management platform for content providers, including multimedia bookings, packages and bundles, inventory management, and finance/credit control. The PCG segment provides sales and marketing consulting services. It serves publishers, information providers, academic libraries, and institutions. The company was formerly known as Publishing Technology Plc and changed its name to Ingenta plc in May 2016. Ingenta plc was incorporated in 1965 and is based in Oxford, the United Kingdom.
